about: The Secret of the feast of the Most Holy Trinity. It asks that the oblation be sanctified by invocation of God's holy name and that those who offer it themselves be perfected as an everlasting gift to God.

seg.tr: Sanctify, we beseech Thee, O Lord our God, by the invocation of Thy holy name, the victim of this oblation; and by it perfect us ourselves as an everlasting gift to Thee. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,

a.g: who liveth and reigneth with Thee
